ques: Open the Blitz leaderboard (the /leaderboard/live page). Report the username of the player ranked #3, their rating, and the exact number of games they have won (the number in the Won column of their row).
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open the Blitz leaderboard (/leaderboard/live). (2) The answer MUST report the username of the rank #3 player, their rating, and the number in the Won column of their row as shown on that page. (3) Empty answer = FAIL. Accept natural wording, number words and thousands separators; reject facts taken from another leaderboard category or another rank.

ques: Look at the top 3 players on the Blitz leaderboard (/leaderboard/live) and the top 3 on the Bullet leaderboard (/leaderboard/live/bullet). Which username appears in the top 3 of BOTH leaderboards? Also report the rating of the #1 bullet player.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open BOTH /leaderboard/live and /leaderboard/live/bullet. (2) The answer MUST name the one username present in the top 3 of both leaderboards and report the #1 Bullet player's rating from the Bullet page. (3) Empty answer = FAIL. Accept equivalent number formats; reject a wrong overlap player or wrong rating.

ques: On page 1 of the Blitz leaderboard (/leaderboard/live), check the country flag next to each of the top 10 players. How many of the top 10 are from the United States, and what are their usernames?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open /leaderboard/live. (2) The answer MUST state how many of the top 10 players are from the United States (their flags) and list those usernames. (3) Empty answer = FAIL. Accept count digits or number words; reject a wrong count or wrong usernames.

judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: (1) The trajectory MUST open /leaderboard/live/rapid. (2) The answer MUST report the username and rating of the player ranked exactly #50 (the last row of page 1). (3) Empty answer = FAIL.

ques: In the News section, find the article announcing the winners of the 2026 Sinquefield Cup and Cairns Cup (published in August 2026) and open the article. According to the article body, how much prize money did the Cairns Cup winner take home, and with what score did she win the tournament?

(2) The answer MUST report, from the article body, the Cairns Cup winner's prize money and the score she won the tournament with. (3) Empty answer = FAIL. Accept equivalent money/score formats ($65,000 or 65000; 6.5, 6½ or six and a half).
